name: autoreview
tagline_zh: 提交前自动审代码，默认用 Codex，也可换 Claude、Pi 或 Kimi。别等 CI 报错才后悔。
tagline_en: Auto code review before commit—Codex by default, or swap in Claude, Pi, or Kimi. Catch issues before CI does.
desc_en: Pre-commit/ship code review: Codex default; optional Claude, Pi, or Kimi.
why_zh: 同类工具只给一个模型，它让你自由切换三家，且默认最稳的 Codex，机制上更灵活。
why_en: Unlike one-model tools, it lets you switch between Codex, Claude, Pi, or Kimi—defaulting to the most reliable, so you're never.
